edges.reason: Constructor parameter _newImplementation is stored into the implementation state variable.
Constructor parameter _operator is stored into the operator state variable.
Constructor parameter _validatorFactory is stored into the validatorFactory state variable.
_newValidatorImplementation is written to implementation, changing the delegatecall target.
_newOperator is written to the operator state variable.
setValidatorImplementation is gated by the isValidatorFactory modifier comparing msg.sender with validatorFactory.
setOperator is gated by the isValidatorFactory modifier comparing msg.sender with validatorFactory.
Context._msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
renounceOwnership is protected by onlyOwner, which compares owner() with msg.sender.
transferOwnership is protected by onlyOwner, which compares owner() with msg.sender.
owner() is read inside the onlyOwner guard of renounceOwnership.
owner() is read inside the onlyOwner guard of transferOwnership.
The Ownable constructor passes _msgSender() as the initial owner.
Constructor calls _transferOwnership, granting ownership to the deployer without an access check.
renounceOwnership delegates the ownership write to _transferOwnership.
transferOwnership delegates the ownership write to _transferOwnership.
newOwner is forwarded from transferOwnership into _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership writes the new owner into the _owner state variable.
The new owner parameter is used alongside the cached old owner before overwriting _owner.
The current _owner value is copied into the oldOwner local variable.
The cached oldOwner local is only used for the event; ownership itself is overwritten by the new owner value.
Proxy._delegate executes the inline-assembly delegatecall operation.
The implementation address parameter flows directly into the delegatecall target.
The delegatecall result flag controls whether the proxy reverts or returns the returndata.
_fallback calls _delegate after running the before-fallback hook.
_fallback reads the delegatecall target from _implementation().
The external fallback function forwards unmatched calls into _fallback.
The receive function forwards empty-calldata value transfers into _fallback.
_fallback invokes the _beforeFallback hook prior to delegation.
_implementation returns the implementation state variable.
Any external fallback call reaches the delegatecall sink, so an untrusted caller controls the code executed inside the proxy context.
The delegatecall target is attacker-influenced code that can re-enter and mutate proxy storage during delegation.
Untrusted callers reach the fallback path that leads to the delegatecall, with no caller validation on the fallback entrypoint.
